criteria.name: Product specificity
criteria.notes: HiHarness API documentation specifies single reference image input via URL or Base64 with aspect ratio preservation; no hands-on testing with an exact ASIN reference has been performed.

criteria.name: Output quality
criteria.notes: Reported #4 on Artificial Analysis Image to Video With Audio leaderboard and #8 on Arena.ai blind test; press reports 1080p high fidelity; no AIVP independent output artifact or hands-on evaluation.

criteria.name: Workflow strength
criteria.notes: Async task submission and status polling API documented on HiHarness; native multimodal audio and video co-generation claimed; creator production workflow and editor integration untested.

criteria.name: Control and consistency
criteria.notes: Press claims physical law integration (gravity, inertia, collisions) and structured narrative planning; prompt controllability and cross-run consistency unverified hands-on.

criteria.name: Speed and reliability
criteria.notes: Async API endpoints specified; queue duration, render latency, failure rates, and task timeouts remain unmeasured.

criteria.name: Cost efficiency
criteria.notes: Enterprise MaaS and subscription models referenced on developer portal; token or per-generation credit debit is not published in public documentation; accepted-output cost unmeasured.

criteria.name: Commercial rights
criteria.notes: Developer portal positions platform for enterprise commercial production; explicit public terms of service with unencumbered monetized output rights grant not confirmed.

criteria.name: Automation and integration
criteria.notes: Callable HTTP REST API documented on HiHarness with JSON request/response schema and polling status endpoint.

criteria.name: AU creator/SMB fit
criteria.notes: Reference-based product video generation with audio is highly relevant to AU SMBs, but AU latency, local payment support, and region accessibility are unverified.

criteria.name: Monetization fit
criteria.notes: High search intent on new top-tier benchmarked model; no active affiliate or partner programme discovered.

analysis: The September 15 launch is supported by official developer documentation on HiHarness and press coverage citing benchmark positions (#4 Artificial Analysis with audio, #8 Arena.ai). However, without hands-on testing, exact-product identity preservation, multi-run consistency, actual render latency, credit costs, and end-user commercial rights remain unverified.
confidence_notes: Confidence C: Evaluated from official API documentation and reputable launch reporting only. No hands-on AIVP runs or verified artifacts exist. Under hard standing rules, no tool may be classified as Category leader or Strong specialist below confidence B.
